Problem Statement

Teachers spend 3–5 hours per week manually creating assessments. Existing tools are generic and don't align to curriculum objectives, forcing extra editing work.

User Personas & Pain Points

Classroom Teachers

Time-consuming question creation not aligned to syllabus

School Administrators

No visibility into assessment quality or coverage gaps

Students

Repetitive, low-quality questions that don't test deep understanding

Solution

An AI-native tool that generates curriculum-aligned questions from uploaded lesson content in seconds, with teacher-in-the-loop editing, difficulty controls, and export to popular formats.

Goals & Success Metrics

  • Reduce assessment creation time by 70%
  • Achieve 80% teacher satisfaction rate within 3 months
  • Expand to 20 schools by end of 2026

Feature Set

Upload & Parse: Upload PDFs, slides, or paste content; AI parses and extracts key concepts
Smart Generation: Generate MCQ, short answer, and essay questions with adjustable difficulty
Curriculum Alignment: Tag questions to learning objectives and Bloom's taxonomy levels
Analytics Dashboard: Track question usage, teacher edits, and coverage gaps (roadmap)
Multi-format Export: Export to Google Forms, Word, and PDF (roadmap)

Tools & Stack

Claude CodeCursorFigma AIGeminiReactNext.js

Outcomes & Results

Adopted by 4 local schools, with positive feedback from teachers citing significant time savings. Roadmap for 2026 includes analytics dashboard, curriculum alignment scoring, and multi-format export.
